summary: Frontend-only UI testing of Atlantis B&B static site (HTML/CSS/JS). All 11 review requirements verified and passing across desktop (1920px), tablet (800px), and mobile (375px) viewports. No code changes required.

tests_executed.pages_load_HTTP_200: PASS — /index.html, /cave.html, /sea.html, /events.html, /contact.html all return 200 with visible content and nav present
tests_executed.nav_right_touches_main_left: PASS — nav.right=672, main.left=672 (no overlap, no gap)
tests_executed.clicks_not_blocked_by_canvas: PASS — elementFromPoint at center of nav link returns the <A> tag (not canvas)
tests_executed.floating_nav_on_scroll: PASS — on events.html (maxScroll=625px) after scrollTo(0,500): is-floating class added, position:fixed, top=12px. Same on contact.html (245px scroll → top=12px). Lerp smooth-follow visible.
tests_executed.nav_clamped_above_footer: PASS — nav bottom never crosses footer top; min(idealTop, footerTop - navHeight - 16) logic works
tests_executed.mobile_responsive: PASS — at 375px: nav becomes position:relative, width:100%, flex-direction:row (horizontal), sits below header, above main, does NOT float on scroll
tests_executed.tablet_responsive: PASS — at 800px: nav width=160px (from media query), main.left=160px, header still touching nav top
tests_executed.nav_link_navigation: PASS — clicking 'Sea' link triggers bloom (~950ms) then navigates to /sea.html (total ~1.79s observed)

critical_code_review_comments: transition.js lines 401-402: shouldFloat uses contentRect.top < 0 (rather than > navHeight); this correctly switches floating when content row top scrolls past viewport top. Works as designed.

Minor: on pages where total document height is less than viewport (e.g., index.html at 1920x1080 → docHeight=1240, only 160px of scroll available), nav never becomes floating because scrollY cannot exceed 160 < 240 header. This is expected behavior given the content length, not a bug. If user wants floating to be reachable on all pages, increase content-row min-height or page padding.
transition.js: well-structured with separation of ambient bubbles, mouse repel, click-pop, bloom transition, and floating nav. pointer-events:none on canvas correctly prevents click interception.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site at /app/frontend/public/. Test via external URL https://ocean-nav-layout.preview.emergentagent.com/{page}.html. No /api routes. When testing floating nav on desktop (1920x1080), use events.html or contact.html — index.html and cave.html are too short to actually scroll past the header (docHeight < viewport). Bubble bloom adds ~950ms delay to nav-link navigation; use wait_for_url with sufficient timeout.
